readiness_authority_caveat: The readiness receipt authorizes the exact pre-implementation descriptor, TEST-SPEC, scope and commands. This descriptor is promoted after implementation, so its current digest intentionally differs; the historical receipt must not be repinned.

write_scope_constraints.migration_013: create only runtime_agent_attempts, runtime_attempt_snapshot_bindings, agent_continuations and agent_continuation_mapping_members; direct parent relations to confirmed_dispatches, confirmed_turn_graphs and continuation_input_mappings; zero backfill; no legacy schema or row mutation
write_scope_constraints.database: register ordered migration 013 only; do not move service or repository methods into database.py
write_scope_constraints.continuation: pure strict projection, UTC deadline derivation, ordered mapping validation, semantic-intent construction and closed lifecycle reducer; no SQLite, journal, service, adapter, filesystem, clock or legacy import
write_scope_constraints.service: application authorization and orchestration; read-only SELECTs through database.connect(); mutation SQL only inside the connection supplied by RuntimeJournal.accept; no database.write(), commit, second transaction/writer, caller scope/key or repository relocation
write_scope_constraints.errors: bounded fail-closed vocabulary only, including continuation_mixed_source_state
write_scope_constraints.focused_test: owns the complete test-only AttemptLifecycle fixture and wires requested, starting, running and completed schemas/validators directly to RuntimeJournal.accept; no production attempt-writer symbol and no production ACI_SCHEMAS widening

write_scope_constraints.stage_e: preserve CONF-001 and baseline repairs; bind final task-owned bytes, refresh manifest/local-pilot pin, append revalidation evidence and refresh the companion digest only
write_scope_constraints.single_writer: one coder owns all listed paths until independent validation handoff

migration_model.legacy: schema, rows, foreign keys and behavior unchanged

acceptance_ordering.existing_continuation: reconstruct command, continuation.suspended event and semantic_intent from persisted bytes; invoke RuntimeJournal.accept for derived-key replay/drift before consulting current official facts
acceptance_ordering.new_continuation_precheck: read the exact two confirmed source_message facts and require zero-of-two
acceptance_ordering.new_continuation_transaction_check: inside the RuntimeJournal.accept mutation closure, requery the exact source_message facts and require zero-of-two before any insert
acceptance_ordering.fact_after_commit: byte-identical retry returns the first receipt without re-evaluating newer official facts
acceptance_ordering.drift: caller drift conflicts, including provider_continuation_ref_digest when supplied as part of the operation

deadline_contract: deadline_utc = confirmed_at + wall_clock_seconds using UTC arithmetic; audit opening does not extend or replace confirmation authority

awaited_mapping_contract.query_identity: the exact two confirmed source_message_id values
awaited_mapping_contract.zero_official_facts: accept with both mapping IDs awaited in confirmed order
awaited_mapping_contract.one_or_two_or_ambiguous_official_facts: reject continuation_mixed_source_state with zero write; defer semantics to CONT-002

required_changes: recognize persisted derived-key replay before current official-fact evaluation
reconstruct replay command, event and semantic intent from persisted continuation bytes
for create only, precheck and transactionally revalidate exact zero-of-two before inserts
preserve the first receipt when an official fact arrives after commit
conflict on drift in every semantic-intent discriminator, including an operation-supplied provider handle digest

test_matrix.migration: apply/reopen idempotence, exact four isolated tables, direct CONF-001 parents, zero backfill and unchanged legacy schema/rows
test_matrix.prerequisite: journal-backed full lifecycle, immutable terminal snapshot event/offset link, no seeded terminal row, no production writer/schema widening
test_matrix.authority: CONF-001-derived identities plus caller, legacy, cross-dispatch, wrong-seat/instance/turn and target-exists negatives
test_matrix.awaited_facts: zero, one, two, duplicate and ambiguous official-source cases; fact inserted between precheck and mutation closure rejects with zero write
test_matrix.atomicity: all failpoints leave all-or-none continuation, members, event, head and receipt; zero effects
test_matrix.replay: existing continuation rebuilds persisted command/event/intent before fact reads; a fact accepted after commit does not invalidate retry; drift in every semantic discriminant, including supplied provider handle digest, conflicts
test_matrix.lifecycle: T-ACI-CONT1 and L2/base T-ACI-CONT9 closed state/event matrix
test_matrix.regression: CONF-001 with only the migration-13 expectation/name/checksum/reopen amendment and all AUTH1-8 assertions preserved; agent reference delivery, traceability, Stage-C, bridge, complete runtime discovery, compileall and diff check
